sector: Generic/cross-sector (circular supply chain; construction benchmark, transfer to discrete manufacturing, process industries, waste management)
hitl_conditions: No explicit conditions; runtime exceptions (persistent guard hits, KPI drift) trigger an automated heuristic fallback and offline retraining rather than a human; managers select the service-versus-externality operating point and calibrate site-specifically before deployment.
key_finding: A five-agent cooperative MARL controller trained in a simulation-based circular-supply-chain DT cut lead time 4.5% and raised OTIF 1.8 p.p. versus no action with bounded cost/CO2 increases, preserved effect signs under shocks, transferred across sectors without retuning; integrated data shifted operations toward lower cost and CO2.

quotes.text: an integrated methodological framework is proposed by coupling a simulation-based DT with cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Specifically, a five-agent controller was trained to coordinate planning, inventory, logistics, expediting, and recycling decisions under a shared multi-objective reward

The focal system represents a single-commodity, two-echelon supply chain consisting of a production site, a consolidation node for outbound shipments, and customer demand aggregated at regional sinks. A reverse loop returns recovered materials to upstream stages
Live data streams from physical operations were not used; instead, synthetic trajectories were generated according to the distributional assumptions and parameter ranges reported in Tables 3 and 4.

At deployment, exploration is disabled and only greedy actions are executed. The feasibility (safety) layer remains active, enforcing capacity, non-negativity, service-window, and expedite limits before the DT advances the system.
When any hook remains active for multiple consecutive steps, a conservative heuristic fallback policy is triggered and an offline retraining job is scheduled on the updated data distributions.
It was shown that the preferred operating point is context-dependent, and it should be selected according to the relative priority placed on service versus externalities.

ft_note: Incluido: gemelo digital basado en simulación (datos sintéticos, sin flujos en vivo) acoplado a MARL cooperativo de cinco agentes que ejecuta decisiones de planificación, inventario, logística, expedición y reciclaje en cadena circular de dos escalones. Dudas: ¿DT o modelo digital?; rol humano no discutido (solo fija pesos/umbrales); Source y extremo a extremo no cubiertos.
